</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 600 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 or 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Trident](/Weapons.aspx?ID=45)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+1 [trident](/Weapons.aspx?ID=45)_, usually engraved with a decorative pattern resembling fish scales, is a common weapon among warriors of aquatic ancestries.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You extend or shorten the trident’s haft. When extended, the trident requires two hands to wield and gains the [reach](/Traits.aspx?ID=192) trait, but loses the trident’s normal [thrown](/Traits.aspx?ID=195) trait.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
